title: Mamak Dua Pagi
mood: belonging to a crowd by accident
subject: watching football on a big screen at a mamak stall at two in the morning
caption: Malaysian pop yeh-yeh in the 1960s kugiran beat-band style. Clean twangy lead electric guitar drenched in spring reverb playing the melody, rhythm guitar strumming straight eighths, a simple walking electric bass, a busy snare-driven drum kit in a twist and beat feel, a cheap combo organ in the chorus. Recorded like a live 1960s four-piece in one room, roomy and mono-leaning. Bright youthful male lead with no melisma, answered by a group of backing singers shouting yeh-yeh responses. 148 BPM, G major. Belonging to a crowd by accident. No modern production, no synth, no programmed drums, no ballad section, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - spring-reverb lead guitar and busy snare]

[Verse 1]
Pukul dua pagi, kedai mamak, skrin besar depan longkang
Liverpool main, separuh kedai sokong, separuh lagi cuma nak teh
Aku tak minat bola, aku datang sebab semua orang datang
Aku jerit bila mereka jerit, aku tak tahu siapa jaring

[Chorus - with group backing]
Mamak dua pagi, yeh yeh
Roti canai kosong, teh o ais limau
Tak ada siapa tanya aku kerja apa
Semua orang cuma tanya "skor berapa?"

[Verse 2]
Pakcik meja sebelah peluk aku bila gol masuk
Kami tak kenal, dia peluk kuat-kuat
Lepas tu dia duduk balik, macam tak ada apa berlaku
Esok kalau jumpa kat pasar, dia takkan ingat aku

[Chorus - with group backing]
Mamak dua pagi, yeh yeh
Roti canai kosong, teh o ais limau
Tak ada siapa tanya aku kerja apa
Semua orang cuma tanya "skor berapa?", dan aku dah tahu jawab

[Outro - guitar twang, cut]
Dua satu
Aku pun bersorak
[Song ends abruptly]
